data.description: 【伊冯 · 宿舍打机】基地宿舍的深夜，伊冯窝在电竞椅里打联机游戏，时尚休闲装被空调吹得懒洋洋，屏幕光把她的侧脸照成一片蓝粉——「这把打完绝对上分……什么？维修报告？明天再说！」
data.promptProse: Yvonne curls into the gaming chair in her base dormitory, playing an online game in her coordinated fashion-casual outfit. Her polished fingertips operate the controls in the medium view, with the monitor angled beside her and the desk extending toward the room wall. At midnight, blue-and-pink screen light colors her cheek and twin tails; a night lamp adds warm edges to the chair and nearby desktop.
data.title: 伊冯 · 宿舍打机
